currencyGate.title: Pick your base currency first
currencyGate.description: We need to know which currency you record your purchases in before we read the photos. Without it, the total we find could end up in the wrong currency.

upload.title: Upload the screenshot
upload.description: We read your photos and fill in the order.
upload.helper: Upload as many photos as you need. PNG, JPEG and WebP are accepted.
upload.dragPasteHint: Drag them here or paste from your clipboard
upload.linkHint: Attach a screenshot of its store page: that is where the name comes from. Adding it later means reading every photo again.
upload.guidanceOneOrder: Upload one order at a time: everything merges into one.
upload.guidanceOrder: We read them in order: the chat first, product pages last.
upload.reorderHint: Drag the photos to change the order, or use the arrows on each photo.

quota.counter: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} left this month
quota.explainer: Every photo you upload spends one from your monthly bag.
quota.helper: Upload as many photos as you need. Each photo spends one from your monthly quota.
quota.overflow: You are about to upload {attached, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} and you have {remaining} left. Remove {excess} or save the rest for next month.
quota.exhaustedTitle: You have used your {limit} AI photos for this month.
quota.exhausted: They renew on {renewalDate}. You can keep adding orders by hand, with no limit and every feature.

processing.title: Reading your photos
processing.subtitle: This usually takes three to eight seconds. Do not close this screen.

errors.title: We could not continue
errors.emptySubmission: Attach at least one photo to continue.
errors.tooManyImages: That is a lot of photos for a single upload. Send up to 20 at a time.
errors.fileTooLarge: One of the photos is too large. The maximum is 2 MB.
errors.submissionTooLarge: Those photos are too heavy for a single upload. Remove a few and try again.
errors.unsupportedFormat: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are accepted.
errors.unreadableFile: We could not read the photo. Try another file.
errors.dimensionsOutOfRange: One of the photos is too small or too large to read.
errors.compressionFailed: We could not prepare one of the photos. Try another file.
errors.budgetBlocked: AI reading is paused for now. You can add the order by hand, with no limit and every feature.
errors.rateLimited: Wait a few seconds before sending more photos.
errors.quotaExceeded: You do not have enough photos left this month. Remove a few or add the order by hand.
errors.dailyCapExceeded: You have reached today's photo limit. Come back tomorrow or add the order by hand.
errors.dailyAttemptCapExceeded: There were too many reading attempts today. Come back tomorrow or add the order by hand.
errors.invalidModelResponse: We did not understand what was in the photos. Try a clearer screenshot.
errors.noOrderFound: We could not find an order in those photos. It usually happens when the photo only shows the product: we need the conversation or the receipt, the one where the products and the amounts appear. Remove the photo that does not belong and try another one.
errors.multipleOrders: Those photos look like several separate purchases. Each order is uploaded on its own, even when it has several products. Remove the extra photos and keep only the ones from a single purchase.
errors.providerError: We could not read the photos right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.providerRejected: Something went wrong reading the photos. Trying again will not fix it: we have already been notified and we are on it. In the meantime you can add the order by hand.
errors.ledgerError: We could not finish the reading. Try again in a minute.
errors.productCeilingExceeded: That is too many products for one order. The chat asks for {productCount} and an order takes {maxProducts}. Merge them into a single product or split the purchase into two orders.
errors.missingBaseCurrency: Pick your base currency in settings first.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.saveInvalidDraft: Some data is missing to create the order. Check the store, the date, the currency and the total.
errors.saveTotalRequired: Enter the order total before saving.

review.title: Review and confirm
review.headerWithDoubts: We found {productCount, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} for {total}. {doubtCount, plural, one {Check # detail and save.} other {Check # details and save.}}
review.headerClean: Everything came out clean from the chat. Review it and save.

edit.blankName: Product {position} was left without a name. Give it one so the order can be saved.

store.label: Store
store.help: Pick it from your list so the order can be saved.

provenance.assumedHint: The chat does not say it. We filled it in, so it is worth a look.
provenance.missingHint: We did not find it in the chat. Fill it in if you know it.
provenance.totalHint: The chat states no total. Add up the products or type it in.

fx.label: Exchange rate {from} to {to}
fx.rateDate: Rate from {date}. You can change it.
fx.unavailable: We could not look up today's rate. Type it in or leave it empty: the order is saved either way and you can reconcile it later from the list.
fx.invalid: Enter a valid number with up to 6 decimals, or leave the field empty.

group.split: We split it into {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}.
group.splitWhy: They were sold together, but they can reach you on different days.
group.splitDoubt: We split it, but we are not sure.
group.splitDoubtWhy: If it ships sealed from the publisher, merge it back into one.
group.sealed: We kept it as a single product.
group.sealedWhy: It ships sealed from the publisher, so it arrives complete or not at all.
group.notNameable: We could not tell what is inside.
group.notNameableWhy: We saved it as one product.
group.openRange: We split it into {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}.
group.openRangeWhy: The chat asks for a range, so we created one product per number.
group.sourceQuoteNotNameable: The chat says "{phrase}" without saying which ones.
group.summaryMeta: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} · {unitPrice} each · {total}
group.priceSplitUneven: We split {total} evenly. Adjust it if one piece is worth more than the other
group.categoryGroupAria: Category for all {count} products: {category}. Change it
group.referenceLinkAria: Open the product link on {host}, in a new tab
group.editCollapsedHint: Open the {count} to correct a name or a price.
group.priceNotANumber: Write the price as a number, with no thousands separators and no symbols. For example: 115.00
group.categorySuggestedHint: The categories are our suggestions. Change any that do not fit.

productSheet.title: {count, plural, one {We can name this product better} other {We can name these # products better}}
productSheet.reasonHostOnly: All we got from the link is the domain: "{name}". The chat never says which product it is.
productSheet.reasonDoubtful: We read "{name}" from the {host} link, but we are not sure what it is.
productSheet.body: Attach a screenshot of the product page and we will name it from there. The price and the total still come from the chat, never from the product page.
productSheet.cost: Reading again spends the {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} you already uploaded one more time, plus the new one: the reading is a single pass over every photo.
productSheet.costWithBalance: Reading again spends the {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} you already uploaded one more time, plus the new one: the reading is a single pass over every photo. You have {remaining} left this month.
productSheet.costUnaffordable: Reading again would cost {needed, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} (the ones you already uploaded plus the new one) and you have {remaining} left this month.
productSheet.optional: It is optional: you can save it as is and rename it later.

payments.title: Payments
payments.empty: We found no payments in the chat.

totals.mismatchTitle: The products do not add up to the total
totals.mismatchBody: The products add up to {products} and the order total says {total}. We save the total as it is: check which of the two is right.

delivery.costNotSaved: We read it from the chat, but it is only saved once you register the delivery.

share.attach: We could not find the photos you shared. Attach them here and we will take it from there.
share.ios: On iPhone the shortcut opens this screen, but it cannot bring the photos with it. Attach the photos you shared.
share.failed: We could not receive what you shared. Attach the photos here and try again.

entry.wizardHint: Got a screenshot? Create it from an image
